name: Climate Science Communication and Research Ethics
description: This course integrates climate science communication with research ethics and responsible scientific practice. Students will learn how to interpret and communicate scientific findings clearly while adhering to ethical standards. Topics include scientific writing, visualization, citation practices, plagiarism, research design basics, institutional ethics approval processes, and responsible use of AI tools in analysis and writing. The course emphasizes transparency, integrity, and accountability in scientific work.
